groups.name: iqkv.db
groups.description: Intermediary database connection properties. Values are composed into spring.datasource by the base config; override per profile via DB_* environment variables.

groups.name: iqkv.rabbitmq
groups.description: Intermediary RabbitMQ connection properties. Values are composed into spring.rabbitmq by the base config.

groups.name: iqkv.messaging.rabbitmq
groups.description: RabbitMQ messaging toggles. 'enabled' drives @ConditionalOnProperty in RabbitMQConfig and TenantProvisioningConsumer.

groups.name: iqkv.platform
groups.description: Platform-wide operational settings. Must be consistent across all core services (IAM, Billing, CMS, etc.) — they all read the same ROLLOUT_MODE environment variable.

groups.name: iqkv.tenancy
groups.description: Tenancy settings shared by the platform. Declared here for consistency with the other services; tenant routing itself is handled by the foundation-tenancy library.

groups.name: iqkv.liquibase
groups.description: Tenant-aware Liquibase migration configuration consumed by the foundation-tenancy TenantLiquibaseRunner.

groups.name: iqkv.billing
groups.description: Billing service integration consumed by the foundation-entitlement-plan-resolver-mvc PlanResolver for quota / plan enforcement.

groups.name: iqkv.auth
groups.description: Authentication and JWT configuration. This service is a JWT resource server — it verifies tokens issued by IAM and never issues its own.

groups.name: iqkv.auth.jwt
groups.description: JWT token verification settings. Exactly one of jwks-uri or public-key-path must be non-blank — an IllegalStateException is thrown at startup if both or neither are set.

properties.name: iqkv.db.host
properties.description: Database server hostname.

properties.name: iqkv.db.port
properties.description: Database server port.

properties.name: iqkv.db.name
properties.description: Database name. Replace 'servicename' with the actual service name when instantiating the template.

properties.name: iqkv.db.username
properties.description: Database username.

properties.name: iqkv.db.password
properties.description: Database password.

properties.name: iqkv.rabbitmq.host
properties.description: RabbitMQ broker hostname.

properties.name: iqkv.rabbitmq.port
properties.description: RabbitMQ broker AMQP port.

properties.name: iqkv.rabbitmq.username
properties.description: RabbitMQ username.

properties.name: iqkv.rabbitmq.password
properties.description: RabbitMQ password.

properties.name: iqkv.messaging.rabbitmq.enabled
properties.description: Enables RabbitMQ messaging (MESSAGING_ENABLED env var). When false, RabbitMQConfig and TenantProvisioningConsumer are skipped. Defaults to false for local safety; the Helm chart configmap sets it per environment and the local profile enables it.

properties.name: iqkv.platform.rollout-mode
properties.description: Platform-wide operational mode (ROLLOUT_MODE env var). Must be the same value across all core services. MULTI_TENANT: each signup creates a new tenant. SINGLE_TENANT: all users join a single pre-provisioned tenant.

properties.name: iqkv.tenancy.default-tenant-key
properties.description: Default tenant key for SINGLE_TENANT mode. Format: 8 characters using alphabet [a-z0-9], e.g. abc12345. Must match the IAM service.

properties.name: iqkv.tenancy.default-tenant-name
properties.description: Display name for the default tenant in SINGLE_TENANT mode (DEFAULT_TENANT_NAME env var).

properties.name: iqkv.tenancy.schema-prefix
properties.description: PostgreSQL schema name prefix for tenant schemas.

properties.name: iqkv.tenancy.default-schema
properties.description: Default (system) schema name.

properties.name: iqkv.tenancy.provisioning-timeout
properties.description: Maximum time allowed for tenant schema provisioning.

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.tenant-runner-enabled
properties.description: Registers the foundation-tenancy TenantLiquibaseRunner so pending changesets are applied to every tenant schema on startup. Read via @ConditionalOnProperty in TenancyAutoConfiguration; not a field of LiquibaseConfigurationProperties.

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.system-change-log
properties.description: Classpath location of the system (public schema) Liquibase changelog.

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.tenant-change-log
properties.description: Classpath location of the per-tenant schema Liquibase changelog.

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.contexts
properties.description: Active Liquibase contexts. Set to 'demo' on non-production profiles to apply demo seed changelogs; omit for schema-only. Not set in the base config.

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.bootstrap-tenants
properties.description: Tenant keys whose schemas are migrated during bootstrap, in addition to the system schema. Not set in the base config.

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.upgrade-existing-tenants
properties.description: Whether the TenantLiquibaseRunner scans and upgrades already-provisioned tenant schemas on startup. Set to false when migrations are managed out-of-band or before any tenant schemas exist.

properties.name: iqkv.billing.service-url
properties.description: Base URL of the billing service used for quota / plan enforcement (BILLING_SERVICE_URI env var). Consumed by the entitlement PlanResolver.

properties.name: iqkv.billing.plan-refresh-interval
properties.description: How often the plan catalog cache is refreshed, as an ISO-8601 duration string (BILLING_PLAN_REFRESH_INTERVAL env var).

properties.name: iqkv.auth.jwt.jwks-uri
properties.description: JWKS URI of the IAM service (JWT_JWKS_URI env var). Preferred for deployed (K8s) environments — keys are fetched and cached, and rotation is picked up without redeployment. Mutually exclusive with public-key-path. Example: http://foundation-iam-service/.well-known/jwks.json

properties.name: iqkv.auth.jwt.public-key-path
properties.description: Path to the RSA public key PEM used to verify IAM-issued tokens (JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH env var). Accepts classpath: (tests) or file: (deployed) resources. Ignored when jwks-uri is set.

values.description: Multi-tenant mode: each signup creates a new tenant.
Single-tenant mode: all users join a single pre-provisioned tenant.
Enable RabbitMQ — used by the local, sit, uat and prd profiles.
Disable RabbitMQ — base config default for local safety.
Blank — fall back to iqkv.auth.jwt.public-key-path (local dev / tests).
